title_protection.quote: No person, who is not so licensed may use in connection with his or her name or place of business, the title "genetic counselor," "licensed genetic counselor," "gene counselor," "genetic consultant," "genetic associate," or any words, letters, abbreviations or insignia indicating or implying a person holds a genetic counseling license

disciplinary_grounds.description: A genetic counselor whose license is suspended or revoked must promptly deliver the original license to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A genetic counselor whose license is suspended or revoked or whose surrender of license with or without prejudice has been accepted by the board, shall promptly deliver the original license to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having violated the chapter or RSA 328-F or demonstrated poor professional character disqualifies a licensee from renewal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Have not violated this chapter or RSA 328-F nor demonstrated poor professional character.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing oneself as currently licensed to practice genetic counseling without a valid license is a misdemeanor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person who states or implies by word or act that he or she is currently licensed to practice genetic counseling at a time when he or she does not hold a currently valid license shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disclosing genetic evaluation or counseling information without prior written client consent is a civil violation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person shall disclose any information or results related to a genetic evaluation, assessment, laboratory test, diagnostic study, or written documentation of genetic counseling, to any person other than the client without prior written consent.

definition_quote.value: Practice of genetic counseling means, for the purposes of advising an individual client, a client's family, or other licensed health care professionals: obtaining and evaluating individual, family, and medical histories to determine genetic risk; discussing features, natural history, means of diagnosis, genetic and environmental factors, and management of risk; identifying and coordinating genetic laboratory tests and other diagnostic studies; integrating laboratory results with personal and family history to assess and communicate risk factors; explaining clinical implications of genetic laboratory tests; evaluating the client's responses to the condition or risk of recurrence; and providing written documentation.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of genetic counseling" means, for the purposes of advising an individual client, a client's family, or other licensed health care professionals
